title: WASD Water
summary: Water for 3D games: a node with ocean waves, light through crests, trailing foam, depth colors, refraction, caustics, mirrored scenery, and 16 looks from sea to toon and lava; rivers; floating bodies.
useWhen: A 3D game shows water or another liquid: a sea, lake, pond, river, waterfall, pool, swamp, or lava, realistic or toon, low-poly, or retro, with waves, shore foam, things that float, or a camera that dives.
avoidWhen: 2D games, or a liquid the player never sees up close, where a flat tinted plane is enough.
